title: Ocean Odyssey
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: Create ONE original polished "Ocean Odyssey" key-art image, WIDE 2:1 landscape, opaque.
Scene/backdrop: an ancient submerged pearl palace with weathered sweeping stone arch, sapphire-blue water, turquoise caustic light, lilac and cyan coral gardens, soft descending shafts of underwater light. Keep a quiet dark-blue clearing behind the title. No deity/human character or new religious imagery.
Subject: one luminous iridescent pearl, pink/lilac/sea-blue sheen, nestled in an open scalloped ivory shell with ornate warm-gold edges and restrained turquoise jewel accents. Shell rests naturally on a coral-covered stone shelf; small air bubbles and delicate water movement. Entire shell and pearl compact, about 50% of canvas height, not a full-canvas close-up.
Composition/framing: panoramic 2:1, large two-line title balanced with shell/pearl vignette, generous quiet water margins. Place the whole title and main shell/pearl within x13–87%, y20–80%. Complete shell top and bottom visible, no clipped gold edges. Corals/arch may continue to image edges. Focal pearl and title must remain clear at 256x128.
Style/medium: professional original fantasy game illustration, luxurious nacre and gold material detail, elegant painterly depth, controlled luminous highlights, cohesive premium catalogue.
Text (verbatim): "Ocean Odyssey". Exactly these two words once, two lines, large cream-pearl serif letters with subtle gold bevel and cool cyan reflected edges, excellent contrast and clean readable letter shapes.
Constraints: no other text, no payout claims/slogans, no reels/spin buttons/interface, no logos or watermark, no money piles, no unrelated cultural motifs. One title-card image only.
editPrompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, Ocean Odyssey title card.
Change ONLY the main gold-edged shell and pearl group: shrink it to 88% of its current size around its center, and move it slightly left so the entire shell fits within x63–88% of image width, y28–78% of image height. Repaint exposed areas as matching coral-covered stone shelf and blue water. Preserve exact "Ocean Odyssey" title unchanged, lettering size, underwater palace arch/background, palette, light rays, detail and wide 2:1 opaque canvas. No new words or subjects.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected final master and 768x384 WebP. Exact Ocean Odyssey title. Iridescent pearl, scalloped gold-edged shell, cyan/sapphire water, lilac coral and submerged palace arch preserve identity. No deity characters, extra copy, fake UI or claims.
visualCheck.thumbnail256x128: Inspected at256x128. Exact title legible and shell/pearl clearly recognizable.
visualCheck.crop: Title and full main pearl/shell are inside central80% width/70% height after targeted shell size edit.
